placement.title: Level test
placement.intro: 20 multiple-choice questions on vocabulary, grammar and reading; they get harder as you answer correctly. If you don't know, choose “I don't know” — don't guess!
placement.noPack: The dictionary pack is not installed yet, so the test is unavailable.

placement.resultBody: You answered {correct}/{total} correctly. %PET% will pick words that suit you.
placement.checkpointIntro: 10 questions at the next level (vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening). 80% or more moves you up a level — the first pass of each level earns a reward. If you miss it, you can try again later.
placement.checkpointFailed: Not yet ({n}% needed). Review a bit and try again!

practice.title: Practice
practice.intro: Each session has 10 exercises built from real sentences (Tatoeba) and vocabulary at your level. Finish a session to earn XP.

stats.vsLastWeek: Arrows compare with the previous 7 days.
stats.skillsHint: Updated each time you take the level test.
stats.readyHint: Rating is above your current level — take the level-up check to move on.
stats.noAccuracy: No data yet — do a few exercises or review some cards.

stats.timeHint: Counted only while the Study window is visible and focused. Bars show minutes per day (last 14 days).
stats.noHardest: No forgotten words yet — keep it up!

achDesc.memory: Keep retention at {n}% or more (after at least 100 reviews)

listening.title: Listening
listening.intro: Listen to short dialogues and talks at your level: change the speed, loop a section (A–B), type what you hear and compare. Comprehension questions follow.

reading.title: Reading
reading.intro: Read short passages at your level. Tap a word to look it up and save it, tap 🔊 to hear a sentence. Comprehension questions follow.
reading.hint: Tap a word to look it up · tap 🔊 next to a sentence to hear it.
reading.saveHardHint: Save words above your level to your word list for review
reading.savedMany: Saved {saved} new words ({already} already saved, {missing} not in the dictionary)

grammar.title: Grammar
grammar.intro: Look up grammar points: short explanations, audio examples, tips and quick exercises.

phrasebook.title: Phrasebook
phrasebook.intro: Useful phrases by situation. Tap 🔊 to listen, tap a phrase to copy it.
phrasebook.saveHint: Save this phrase to your cards for review

lessons.title: Foundation lessons
lessons.intro: Start from scratch: alphabet and pronunciation, basic sentence patterns, tenses, everyday communication. Each lesson has an explanation, examples you can listen to, and exercises. (Lesson text is in Vietnamese.)
lessons.tapToHear: Tap a tile to hear the pronunciation.

courses.title: Courses
courses.intro: Each course is an ordered path of lessons: foundations, grammar, reading, listening. Follow the order and your progress is saved automatically.

pet.keepHint: Level and XP belong to your profile — switching pets keeps your progress.
